Adding technical detail here — thanks Lauren. A few notes on the load window and routing checks: 

- For deterministic load results we should use a temporary dedicated pool (2 x A100-equivalent) during the 30m stress window. That isolates KV cache behavior and gives stable latency profiles.
- Suggested load profile: 400 concurrent clients with a 200ms think time, 1.5k tokens average response; ramp 0->100% over 5 minutes, hold 25 minutes, cool down 5 minutes.
- Routing checks: we’ll run failover by toggling policy from low-latency to cost-saver and validate fallback quality metrics using the shared prompts.
- Pre-test checklist: seed prompt set (attached in runbook), test harness (we’ll provide a signed artifact link), and an agreed metric sheet.

I can provision infra but need final confirmation on slot selection by EOD Mon (Nov 29) to avoid conflicts with other reserved runs.
